en.heading: Choose a mate for %{name}
en.info: If a cat has mates, then they will be loyal and only have kittens with their mates (unless affairs are toggled on). Potential mates are listed below! The lines connecting the two cats may give a hint on their compatibility with one another, and any existing romantic feelings will be shown with small hearts.
en.no_kits_pair: m_c has no offspring with r_c.
en.no_kit_warning: This pair can't have biological kittens.
en.became_mates_text1: m_c confessed m_c_pronoun_poss feelings to r_c and they have become mates.
en.became_mates_text2: This has been a long time coming - m_c and r_c have become mates.
en.became_mates_text3: m_c and r_c really think the Clan hasn't noticed how they feel about each other? Everyone carefully hides their smiles as they announce becoming mates.
en.became_mates_text4: m_c and r_c have been practically floating on air since announcing their commitment as mates before c_n.
en.became_mates_text5: Some of the less sympathetic cats of c_n would prefer to hack up a hairball rather than watch m_c and r_c melt in each other's direction. New mates can be insufferable.
en.became_mates_text6: The more romantic members of the Clan sigh, watching the new mates m_c and r_c, who're too caught up in each other to notice.
en.became_mates_text7: In a bright spot this moon, m_c and r_c have finally announced their commitment as mates.
en.became_mates_text8: Their love has been a slow basking warmth, not a wildfire, and m_c wouldn't change it for the world. m_c_pronoun_subject_cap m_c_verb_re_are_is so excited to commit to padding at r_c's side forever.
en.became_mates_text9: It's neither a mystery nor a surprise, but c_n is happy to celebrate m_c and r_c becoming mates regardless.
en.became_mates_text10: m_c and r_c announce they've become mates in the least showy way possible, by combining their nests into one.
en.became_mates_text11: There's such happiness in the promises they make to each other. m_c and r_c leap into their new life as mates without question or hesitation.
en.became_mates_text12: For just this one perfect moment, heads pressed together and speaking their commitment in front of the Clan, there's nothing in m_c and r_c's worlds but love.
en.became_mates_text13: m_c and r_c are very proud to announce their new status as mates - it's quite cute.
en.became_mates_text14: m_c and r_c have become mates.
en.became_mates_text15: It's funny how quickly love takes flight - m_c and r_c have become mates.
en.became_mates_text16: The Clan gathers to celebrate a new pair of mates, m_c and r_c.
en.became_mates_text17: In a bright spot this moon, m_c and r_c have announced their commitment as mates.
en.became_mates_text18: m_c puts m_c_pronoun_poss paw over r_c's, as they announce they've become mates.
en.became_mates_text19: m_c bunts m_c_pronoun_poss head against r_c's as c_n celebrates the new mates.
en.became_mates_text20: It's funny how love has worked for m_c and r_c. Slowly at first, like a little trip or tumble, and then suddenly falling all at once.
en.became_mates_text21: Maybe it's surprising to some cats. It doesn't feel like it should be — m_c is so sure m_c_pronoun_subject m_c_verb_want_want_wants r_c as m_c_pronoun_poss mate, and r_c loves m_c_pronoun_object just as much in return.
en.became_mates_text22: This moon marks the beginning of the rest of their lives together for m_c and r_c.
en.became_mates_text23: Tails twined together, m_c and r_c announce that love has blossomed between them. They've become mates.
en.became_mates_text24: It's endearing how embarrassed m_c is, with m_c_pronoun_object and r_c briefly becoming the center of attention as new mates.
en.became_mates_text25: No one is going to blame m_c for the pride m_c_pronoun_subject m_c_verb_display_displays in successfully asking r_c to become m_c_pronoun_poss mate. It's a wonderful life event to celebrate, and something to rightfully congratulate the couple on.
en.became_mates_text26: m_c and r_c see each other in a different light and have become mates.
en.became_mates_text27: "It's like shedding fur to find a new colour underneath," m_c explains. r_c has been such an important friend — is it so surprising that both their feelings have evolved in this new direction to become mates?
en.became_mates_text28: It surprised them, too. But m_c and r_c are sure of this. So sure. The new mates celebrate with c_n.
en.became_mates_text29: Closeness can bring new aspects to any relationship. m_c glows with contentment, flushed with the thrill of m_c_pronoun_poss new romance with r_c.
en.became_mates_text30: Tails twined together, m_c and r_c announce that love has blossomed between them. They've become mates.
en.became_mates_text31: In a bright spot this moon, m_c and r_c announce that their friendship has had romance added to the mix — they're now mates.
en.became_mates_text32: Sometimes one form of love can grow into another — m_c and r_c no longer only think of each other platonically.
en.became_mates_text33: Love blooms from platonic to romantic, and m_c is now mates with r_c.
en.became_mates_text34: m_c and r_c don't make any big announcements. But when they combine their nests, the Clan realizes that their relationship isn't so platonic anymore.
en.breakup_mates_text1: m_c and r_c lost feelings for each other over time - they broke up this moon.
en.breakup_mates_text2: m_c and r_c realized that they are a lot different from each other than they initially thought. The realization steers them away from the relationship they once had, and they break up.
en.breakup_mates_text3: One day, m_c and r_c were crazy in love with each other. The next day, they're distant, refusing to talk to one another. The distance continues for a while, making it clear that they're no longer mates.
en.breakup_mates_text4: Things sadly just didn't work out the way m_c and r_c thought it would... With heaviness in their hearts, they have decided to break up.
en.breakup_mates_text5: Sometimes, good things must come to an end, m_c and r_c realize as they announce to the Clan that they’re no longer mates.
en.breakup_mates_text6: m_c isn't so sure about continuing a romantic relationship with r_c anymore. After talking with r_c_pronoun_object, they decided to break up.
en.breakup_mates_text7: m_c realizes that m_c_pronoun_subject m_c_verb_dont_doesnt have the mentality to keep a romantic relationship right now. After a little talk with r_c, they have decided to break up.
en.breakup_mates_text9: m_c and r_c have decided that they may not be the right fit for each other after all. They decide to leave off on good terms and break up.
en.breakup_mates_text10: After explaining m_c_pronoun_poss feelings and thoughts to r_c, m_c broke up with r_c_pronoun_object. No hard feelings.
